content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Hi qui amícti sunt * stolis albis, qui sunt, et unde venérunt?
content.english: Ant. What are these * which are arrayed in white robes? And whence came they?

segments.t: Ant.
Hi qui amícti sunt * stolis albis, qui sunt, et unde venérunt?

content.latin: Psalmus 92 [1]
content.english: Psalm 92 [1]

segments.t: Psalmus 92

content.latin: 92:1 Dóminus regnávit, decórem indútus est: * indútus est Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se.
content.english: 92:1 The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty: * the Lord is clothed with strength, and hath girded himself.

segments.t: Dóminus regnávit, decórem indútus est: * indútus est Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se.

content.latin: 92:1 Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.
content.english: 92:1 For he hath established the world * which shall not be moved.

segments.t: Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.

content.latin: 92:2 Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
content.english: 92:2 Thy throne is prepared from of old: * thou art from everlasting.

segments.t: Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up, O Lord: * the floods have lifted up their voice.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.

content.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.
content.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up their waves, * with the noise of many waters.

segments.t: Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.

content.latin: 92:4 Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.
content.english: 92:4 Wonderful are the surges of the sea: * wonderful is the Lord on high.

segments.t: Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.

content.latin: 92:5 Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
content.english: 92:5 Thy testimonies are become exceedingly credible: * holiness becometh thy house, O Lord, unto length of days.

segments.t: Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Hi qui amícti sunt stolis albis, qui sunt, et unde venérunt?
content.english: Ant. What are these which are arrayed in white robes? And whence came they?

segments.t: Ant.
Hi qui amícti sunt stolis albis, qui sunt, et unde venérunt?

content.latin: Ant. Hi sunt * qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
content.english: Ant. These are they which came out of great tribulation, * and have washed their robes and made them white in the Blood of the Lamb.

segments.t: Ant.
Hi sunt * qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.

content.latin: Psalmus 99 [2]
content.english: Psalm 99 [2]

segments.t: Psalmus 99

content.latin: 99:2 Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.
content.english: 99:2 Sing joyfully to God, all the earth: * serve ye the Lord with gladness.

segments.t: Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.

content.latin: 99:2 Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.
content.english: 99:2 Come in before his presence * with exceeding great joy.

segments.t: Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.

content.latin: 99:3 Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.
content.english: 99:3 Know ye that the Lord he is God: * he made us, and not we ourselves.

segments.t: Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.

content.latin: 99:3 Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.
content.english: 99:3 We are his people and the sheep of his pasture. * Go ye into his gates with praise, into his courts with hymns: and give glory to him.

segments.t: Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.

content.latin: 99:4 Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.
content.english: 99:4 Praise ye his name: for the Lord is sweet, his mercy endureth for ever, * and his truth to generation and generation.

segments.t: Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Hi sunt qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
content.english: Ant. These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes and made them white in the Blood of the Lamb.

segments.t: Ant.
Hi sunt qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.

content.latin: Ant. Ideo sunt * ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.
content.english: Ant. Therefore are they before the throne of God, * and serve Him day and night.

segments.t: Ant.
Ideo sunt * ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.

content.latin: Psalmus 62 [3]
content.english: Psalm 62 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 62

content.latin: 62:2 Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
content.english: 62:2 O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.

segments.t: Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.

content.latin: 62:2 Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
content.english: 62:2 For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

segments.t: Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.

content.latin: 62:3 In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
content.english: 62:3 In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

segments.t: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.

content.latin: 62:4 Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
content.english: 62:4 For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

segments.t: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.

content.latin: 62:5 Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
content.english: 62:5 Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

segments.t: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.

content.latin: 62:6 Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
content.english: 62:6 Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

segments.t: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.

content.latin: 62:7 Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
content.english: 62:7 If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.

segments.t: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.

content.latin: 62:8 Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
content.english: 62:8 And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.

segments.t: Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.

content.latin: 62:10 Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
content.english: 62:10 But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

segments.t: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.

content.latin: 62:12 Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
content.english: 62:12 But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

segments.t: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ideo sunt ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.
content.english: Ant. Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve Him day and night.

segments.t: Ant.
Ideo sunt ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.

content.latin: Ant. Et ipsi vicérunt * dracónem propter sánguinem Agni et propter testaméntum Verbi sui.
content.english: Ant. And they overcame the dragon * by the Blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony.

segments.t: Ant.
Et ipsi vicérunt * dracónem propter sánguinem Agni et propter testaméntum Verbi sui.

content.latin: Canticum Trium Puerorum [4]
content.english: Canticle of the Three Young Men [4]

segments.t: Canticum Trium Puerorum

content.latin: 3:57 Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:57 All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:58 Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:58 O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:

segments.t: Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:59 Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:59 O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:60 Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:60 O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:61 Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
content.english: 3:61 O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:62 Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:62 O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:63 Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
content.english: 3:63 O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:64 Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
content.english: 3:64 O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:65 Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
content.english: 3:65 O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:66 Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:66 O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:67 Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
content.english: 3:67 O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:68 Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
content.english: 3:68 O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:69 Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
content.english: 3:69 O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:70 Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
content.english: 3:70 O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:71 Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:71 O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:72 Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
content.english: 3:72 O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:73 Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
content.english: 3:73 O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.

content.latin: 3:74 Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:74 O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:) Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:75 (Bow head) Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.

segments.t: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:)
Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.

content.latin: 3:56 Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
content.english: 3:56 Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

segments.t: Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.

content.latin: Ant. Et ipsi vicérunt dracónem propter sánguinem Agni et propter testaméntum Verbi sui.
content.english: Ant. And they overcame the dragon by the Blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony.

segments.t: Ant.
Et ipsi vicérunt dracónem propter sánguinem Agni et propter testaméntum Verbi sui.

content.latin: Ant. Beáti * qui lavant stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
content.english: Ant. Blessed are they * that wash their robes in the Blood of the Lamb.

segments.t: Ant.
Beáti * qui lavant stolas suas in sánguine Agni.

content.latin: Psalmus 148 [5]
content.english: Psalm 148 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 148

content.latin: 148:1 Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
content.english: 148:1 Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

segments.t: Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.

content.latin: 148:2 Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
content.english: 148:2 Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.

content.latin: 148:3 Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
content.english: 148:3 Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.

content.latin: 148:4 Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
content.english: 148:4 Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

segments.t: Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.

content.latin: 148:5 Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
content.english: 148:5 For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

segments.t: Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.

content.latin: 148:6 Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
content.english: 148:6 He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

segments.t: Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.

content.latin: 148:7 Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.

content.latin: Fratres: Christus assístens Póntifex futurórum bonórum, per ámplius et perféctius tabernáculum non manufáctum, id est, non huius creatiónis: neque per sánguinem hircórum aut vitulórum, sed per próprium sánguinem introívit semel in Sancta, ætérna redemptióne invénta.
content.english: Brethren, Christ being come an High Priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by His Own Blood, He entered in once into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.latin: Hymnus
content.english: Hymn

content.latin: Salvéte, Christi vúlnera,
content.english: Hail, holy wounds of Jesus, hail,

content.latin: Imménsi amoris pígnora
content.english: Sweet pledges of the saving rood,

content.latin: Quibus perénnes rívuli
content.english: Whence flow the streams that never fail,

content.latin: Manant rubéntis sánguinis.
content.english: The purple streams of his dear blood.

content.latin: Nitóre stellas víncitis
content.english: Brighter than brightest stars ye show,

content.latin: Rosas odóre et bálsama,
content.english: Than sweetest rose your scent more rare,

content.latin: Prétio lapíllos Indicos,
content.english: No Indian gem may match your glow,

content.latin: Mellis favos dulcédine.
content.english: No honey's taste with yours compare.

content.latin: Per vos patet gratíssimum
content.english: Portals ye are to that dear home

content.latin: Nostris asýlum méntibus;
content.english: Wherein our wearied souls may hide,

content.latin: Non huc furor minántium
content.english: Whereto no angry foe can come,

content.latin: Umquam penétrat hóstium.
content.english: The heart of Jesus crucified.

content.latin: Quot Iesus in prætório
content.english: What countless stripes our Jesus bore,

content.latin: Flagélla nudus éxcipit!
content.english: All naked left in Pilate's hall!

content.latin: Quot scissa pellis úndique
content.english: From his torn flesh how red a shower

content.latin: Stillat cruóris gúttulas!
content.english: Did round his sacred person fall!

content.latin: Frontem venústam, proh dolor!
content.english: His beauteous brow, oh, shame and grief,

content.latin: Coróna pungit spínea,
content.english: By the sharp thorny crown is riven;

content.latin: Clavi retúsa cúspide
content.english: Through hands and feet, without relief,

content.latin: Pedes manúsque pérforant.
content.english: The cruel nails are rudely driven.

content.latin: Postquam sed ille trádidit
content.english: But when for our poor sakes he died,

content.latin: Amans volénsque spíritum,
content.english: A willing priest by love subdued,

content.latin: Pectus ferítur láncea,
content.english: The soldier's lance transfixed his side,

content.latin: Geminúsque liquor éxsilit.
content.english: Forth flowed the water and the blood.

content.latin: Ut plena sit redémptio,
content.english: In full atonement of our guilt,

content.latin: Sub torculári stríngitur;
content.english: Careless of self, the Saviour trod—

content.latin: Suíque Iesus ímmemor,
content.english: E'en till his heart's best blood was spilt—

content.latin: Sibi nil resérvat sánguinis.
content.english: The wine-press of the wrath of God.

content.latin: Veníte quotquot críminum
content.english: Come, bathe you in the healing flood,

content.latin: Funésta labes ínficit;
content.english: All ye who mourn, by sin opprest;

content.latin: In hoc salútis bálneo
content.english: Your only hope is Jesus' blood,

content.latin: Qui se lavat, mundábitur.
content.english: His sacred heart your only rest.

content.latin: Summi ad Paréntis déxteram
content.english: All praise to him, the Eternal Son,

content.latin: Sedénti habénda est grátia,
content.english: At God's right hand enthroned above,

content.latin: Qui nos redémit sánguine,
content.english: Whose blood our full redemption won,

content.latin: Sanctóque firmat Spíritu.
content.english: Whose Spirit seals the gift of love.

content.english: Amen.

content.latin: 1:68 Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
content.english: 1:68 Blessed be the Lord ✠ God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

content.latin: 1:69 Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
content.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

segments.t: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.

content.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
content.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

segments.t: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:

content.latin: 1:71 Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
content.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

segments.t: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.

content.latin: 1:72 Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
content.english: 1:72 To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

content.english: 1:73 The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

segments.t: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:

content.latin: 1:74 Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
content.english: 1:74 That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

segments.t: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.

content.latin: 1:75 In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
content.english: 1:75 In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

segments.t: In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.

content.latin: 1:76 Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
content.english: 1:76 And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

segments.t: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:

content.latin: 1:77 Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:

segments.t: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:

content.english: 1:78 Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

segments.t: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:

content.english: 1:79 To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui unigénitum Fílium tuum mundi Redemptórem constituísti, ac eius Sánguine placári voluísti: concéde, quǽsumus, salútis nostræ prétium solémni cultu ita venerári, atque a præséntis vitæ malis eius virtúte deféndi in terris; ut fructu perpétuo lætémur in cælis.
content.english: Almighty, eternal God, Who made thy only-begotten Son the Redeemer of the world, and willed to be reconciled by His Blood, grant us, we beseech thee, so to worship in this sacred rite the price of our salvation, and to be so protected by its power against the evils of the present life on earth, that we may enjoy its everlasting fruit in heaven.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: Iam lucis orto sídere,
content.english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,

content.latin: Deum precémur súpplices,
content.english: Lowly of heart, our God we pray

content.latin: Ut in diúrnis áctibus
content.english: That he from harm may keep us free

content.latin: Nos servet a nocéntibus.
content.english: In all the deeds this day shall see.

content.latin: Linguam refrénans témperet,
content.english: May fear of him our tongues restrain,

content.english: Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:

content.latin: Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
content.english: His favouring care our guardian be,

content.latin: Ne vanitátes háuriat.
content.english: Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

content.latin: Sint pura cordis íntima,
content.english: May every heart be pure from sin

content.latin: Absístat et vecórdia;
content.english: And folly find no place therein:

content.latin: Carnis terat supérbiam
content.english: Scant need of food, excess denied,

content.latin: Potus cibíque párcitas.

content.english: That when the light of day is gone,

content.latin: Noctémque sors redúxerit,

content.english: We, free from cares the world affords,

content.english: 53:5 For strangers have risen up against me; and the mighty have sought after my soul: * and they have not set God before their eyes.

segments.t: Tu mandásti * mandáta tua custodíri nimis.

content.latin: 118:5 Útinam dirigántur viæ meæ, * ad custodiéndas iustificatiónes tuas!
content.english: 118:5 O! that my ways may be directed * to keep thy justifications.

segments.t: Útinam dirigántur viæ meæ, * ad custodiéndas iustificatiónes tuas!

content.latin: 118:6 Tunc non confúndar, * cum perspéxero in ómnibus mandátis tuis.
content.english: 118:6 Then shall I not be confounded, * when I shall look into all thy commandments.

segments.t: Tunc non confúndar, * cum perspéxero in ómnibus mandátis tuis.

content.latin: 118:7 Confitébor tibi in directióne cordis: * in eo quod dídici iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.
content.english: 118:7 I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, * when I shall have learned the judgments of thy justice.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi in directióne cordis: * in eo quod dídici iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.

content.latin: 118:8 Iustificatiónes tuas custódiam: * non me derelínquas usquequáque.
content.english: 118:8 I will keep thy justifications: * O! do not thou utterly forsake me.

segments.t: Iustificatiónes tuas custódiam: * non me derelínquas usquequáque.

content.latin: 118:9 (Beth) In quo córrigit adolescéntior viam suam? * In custodiéndo sermónes tuos.
content.english: 118:9 (Béth) By what doth a young man correct his way? * By observing thy words.

segments.t: In quo córrigit adolescéntior viam suam? * In custodiéndo sermónes tuos.

content.latin: 118:10 In toto corde meo exquisívi te: * ne repéllas me a mandátis tuis.
content.english: 118:10 With my whole heart have I sought after thee: * let me not stray from thy commandments.

segments.t: In toto corde meo exquisívi te: * ne repéllas me a mandátis tuis.

content.latin: 118:11 In corde meo abscóndi elóquia tua: * ut non peccem tibi.
content.english: 118:11 Thy words have I hidden in my heart, * that I may not sin against thee.

segments.t: In corde meo abscóndi elóquia tua: * ut non peccem tibi.

content.latin: 118:12 Benedíctus es, Dómine: * doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
content.english: 118:12 Blessed art thou, O Lord: * teach me thy justifications.

segments.t: Benedíctus es, Dómine: * doce me iustificatiónes tuas.

content.latin: 118:13 In lábiis meis, * pronuntiávi ómnia iudícia oris tui.
content.english: 118:13 With my lips * I have pronounced all the judgments of thy mouth.

segments.t: In lábiis meis, * pronuntiávi ómnia iudícia oris tui.

content.latin: 118:14 In via testimoniórum tuórum delectátus sum, * sicut in ómnibus divítiis.
content.english: 118:14 I have been delighted in the way of thy testimonies, * as in all riches.

segments.t: In via testimoniórum tuórum delectátus sum, * sicut in ómnibus divítiis.

content.latin: 118:15 In mandátis tuis exercébor: * et considerábo vias tuas.
content.english: 118:15 I will meditate on thy commandments: * and I will consider thy ways.

segments.t: In mandátis tuis exercébor: * et considerábo vias tuas.

content.latin: 118:16 In iustificatiónibus tuis meditábor: * non oblivíscar sermónes tuos.
content.english: 118:16 I will think of thy justifications: * I will not forget thy words.

segments.t: In iustificatiónibus tuis meditábor: * non oblivíscar sermónes tuos.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 118(17-32)

content.latin: 118:17 (Ghimel) Retríbue servo tuo, vivífica me: * et custódiam sermónes tuos:
content.english: 118:17 (Ghimel) Give bountifully to thy servant, enliven me * and I shall keep thy words.

segments.t: 118:17 (Ghimel)
Retríbue servo tuo, vivífica me: * et custódiam sermónes tuos:

content.latin: 118:18 Revéla óculos meos: * et considerábo mirabília de lege tua.
content.english: 118:18 Open thou my eyes: * and I will consider the wondrous things of thy law.

segments.t: Revéla óculos meos: * et considerábo mirabília de lege tua.

content.latin: 118:19 Íncola ego sum in terra: * non abscóndas a me mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:19 I am a sojourner on the earth: * hide not thy commandments from me.

segments.t: Íncola ego sum in terra: * non abscóndas a me mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:20 Concupívit ánima mea desideráre iustificatiónes tuas, * in omni témpore.
content.english: 118:20 My soul hath coveted to long for thy justifications, * at all times.

segments.t: Concupívit ánima mea desideráre iustificatiónes tuas, * in omni témpore.

content.latin: 118:21 Increpásti supérbos: * maledícti qui declínant a mandátis tuis.
content.english: 118:21 Thou hast rebuked the proud: * they are cursed who decline from thy commandments.

segments.t: Increpásti supérbos: * maledícti qui declínant a mandátis tuis.

content.latin: 118:22 Aufer a me oppróbrium, et contémptum: * quia testimónia tua exquisívi.
content.english: 118:22 Remove from me reproach and contempt: * because I have sought after thy testimonies.

segments.t: Aufer a me oppróbrium, et contémptum: * quia testimónia tua exquisívi.

content.latin: 118:23 Étenim sedérunt príncipes, et advérsum me loquebántur: * servus autem tuus exercebátur in iustificatiónibus tuis.
content.english: 118:23 For princes sat, and spoke against me: * but thy servant was employed in thy justifications.

segments.t: Étenim sedérunt príncipes, et advérsum me loquebántur: * servus autem tuus exercebátur in iustificatiónibus tuis.

content.latin: 118:24 Nam et testimónia tua meditátio mea est: * et consílium meum iustificatiónes tuæ.
content.english: 118:24 For thy testimonies are my meditation: * and thy justifications my counsel.

segments.t: Nam et testimónia tua meditátio mea est: * et consílium meum iustificatiónes tuæ.

content.latin: 118:25 (Daleth) Adhǽsit paviménto ánima mea: * vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.
content.english: 118:25 (Daleth) My soul hath cleaved to the pavement: * quicken thou me according to thy word.

segments.t: 118:25 (Daleth)
Adhǽsit paviménto ánima mea: * vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.

content.latin: 118:26 Vias meas enuntiávi, et exaudísti me: * doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
content.english: 118:26 I have declared my ways, and thou hast heard me: * teach me thy justifications.

segments.t: Vias meas enuntiávi, et exaudísti me: * doce me iustificatiónes tuas.

content.latin: 118:27 Viam iustificatiónum tuárum ínstrue me: * et exercébor in mirabílibus tuis.
content.english: 118:27 Make me to understand the way of thy justifications: * and I shall be exercised in thy wondrous works.

segments.t: Viam iustificatiónum tuárum ínstrue me: * et exercébor in mirabílibus tuis.

content.latin: 118:28 Dormitávit ánima mea præ tǽdio: * confírma me in verbis tuis.
content.english: 118:28 My soul hath slumbered through heaviness: * strengthen thou me in thy words.

segments.t: Dormitávit ánima mea præ tǽdio: * confírma me in verbis tuis.

content.latin: 118:29 Viam iniquitátis ámove a me: * et de lege tua miserére mei.
content.english: 118:29 Remove from me the way of iniquity: * and out of thy law have mercy on me.

segments.t: Viam iniquitátis ámove a me: * et de lege tua miserére mei.

content.latin: 118:30 Viam veritátis elégi: * iudícia tua non sum oblítus.
content.english: 118:30 I have chosen the way of truth: * thy judgments I have not forgotten.

segments.t: Viam veritátis elégi: * iudícia tua non sum oblítus.

content.latin: 118:31 Adhǽsi testimóniis tuis, Dómine: * noli me confúndere.
content.english: 118:31 I have stuck to thy testimonies, O Lord: * put me not to shame.

segments.t: Adhǽsi testimóniis tuis, Dómine: * noli me confúndere.

content.latin: 118:32 Viam mandatórum tuórum cucúrri, * cum dilatásti cor meum.
content.english: 118:32 I have run the way of thy commandments, * when thou didst enlarge my heart.

segments.t: Viam mandatórum tuórum cucúrri, * cum dilatásti cor meum.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Hi qui amícti sunt stolis albis, qui sunt, et unde venérunt?
content.english: Ant. What are these which are arrayed in white robes? And whence came they?

segments.t: Ant.

content.latin: Regi sæculórum immortáli et invisíbili, soli Deo honor et glória in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: Now to the king of ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.latin: ℣. Exsúrge, Christe, ádiuva nos.
content.english: ℣. Arise, O Christ, and help us.

segments.t: Exsúrge, Christe, ádiuva nos.

content.latin: ℟. Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.
content.english: ℟. And deliver us for thy name's sake.

segments.t: Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium huius diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam iustítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera.
content.english: O Lord, our heavenly Father, Almighty and everlasting God, who has safely brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us by thy mighty power; and grant that this day we fall into no sin, but that all our doings may be ordered by thy governance, to do always what is righteous in thy sight.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.latin: Sexto Nonas Iúlii Luna décima séptima Anno Dómini 2026
content.english: July 2nd 2026, the 17th day of the Moon,

content.latin: Visitátio beátæ Maríæ Vírginis ad Elísabeth.
content.english: On the morrow we keep the feast of the visit of the Blessed Virgin Mary to Elizabeth.

content.latin: Romæ, via Aurélia, natális sanctórum Mártyrum Procéssi et Martiniáni, qui, a beáto Petro Apóstolo in Mamertíni custódia baptizáti, et, sub Neróne, oris contusiónem, equúleum, nervos, fustes, flammas scorpionésque perpéssi, novíssime, gládio percússi, martýrio coronáti sunt.
content.english: On the same 2nd day of July, were born into the better life:

content.latin: Item Romæ pássio sanctórum trium mílitum, qui, ad Christum convérsi in martýrio beáti Pauli Apóstoli, cum eo partícipes fieri cæléstis glóriæ meruérunt.
content.english: At Rome, upon the Aurelian Way, the holy martyrs Processus and Martinian, who were baptized by the blessed Apostle Peter in the Mamertine Prison, and crowned with martyrdom under Nero by being slain with the sword, after suffering the beating of their mouths, the rack, thongs, cudgels, fire, and loaded whips.

content.latin: Eódem die sanctórum Mártyrum Aristónis, Crescentiáni, Eutychiáni, Urbáni, Vitális, Iusti, Felicíssimi, Felícis, Márciæ et Symphorósæ; qui omnes apud Campániam, cum Diocletiáni Imperatóris persecútio desævíret, martýrio coronáti sunt.
content.english: At Rome also, the three holy soldiers who turned to Christ at the martyrdom of the blessed Apostle Paul, and thus earned a share with him in the glory of heaven.

content.latin: Wintóniæ, in Anglia, sancti Swithúni Epíscopi, cuius sánctitas miráculis effúlsit.
content.english: On the same day, the holy martyrs Ariston, Crescentian, Eutychian, Urban, Vitalis, Justus, Felicissimus, Felix, Marcia, and Symphorosa, who were all crowned with martyrdom in the Campania while the persecution was raging under the Emperor Diocletian.

content.latin: Bambérgæ sancti Othónis Epíscopi, qui Pomeránis Evangélium prædicávit, et eos ad fidem convértit.
content.english: At Winchester, in England, the holy Swithin, Bishop of that city, [in the year 863,] whose holiness shone forth in the grace of working miracles, and whose feast day we keep upon the 15th day of this present month of July. [His head was taken to the cathedral of Évreux at the end of the fourteenth century.]

content.latin: Lýciis, in Apúlia, sancti Bernardíni Realíno, Confessóris, qui magistrátus múnere egrégie functus, Societátem Iesu ingréssus et sacerdótio auctus, caritáte ac miráculis incláruit.
content.english: At Bamberg, [in Bavaria,] holy Otto, Bishop of [that see,] who preached the Gospel to the Pomeranians, and turned them to the faith, [in the year 1139.]

content.latin: Turónis, in Gállia, deposítio sanctæ Monegúndis, religiósæ féminæ.
content.english: At Tours, the holy woman Monegund, [about the year 573]

content.latin: ℣. Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
content.english: ℣. And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.

segments.t: Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.

content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

content.english: ℣. Precious in the sight of the Lord

content.english: ℟. Is the death of his saints.

content.latin: Sancta María et omnes Sancti intercédant pro nobis ad Dóminum, ut nos mereámur ab eo adiuvári et salvári, qui vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Holy Mary and all the Saints, intercede for us with the Lord, our God, so that we may merit His help and salvation, who lives and reigns for ever and ever.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.english: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

segments.t: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

content.latin: ℣. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

segments.t: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: ℟. Sed líbera nos a malo.
content.english: ℟. But deliver us from evil.

segments.t: Sed líbera nos a malo.

content.latin: ℣. Réspice in servos tuos, Dómine, et in ópera tua, et dírige fílios eórum.
content.english: ℣. Look upon thy servants and upon thy works: and direct their children.

segments.t: Réspice in servos tuos, Dómine, et in ópera tua, et dírige fílios eórum.

content.latin: ℟. Et sit splendor Dómini Dei nostri super nos, et ópera mánuum nostrárum dírige super nos, et opus mánuum nostrárum dírige.
content.english: ℟. And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us. Direct thou the works of our hands; yea, the work of our hands do thou direct.

segments.t: Et sit splendor Dómini Dei nostri super nos, et ópera mánuum nostrárum dírige super nos, et opus mánuum nostrárum dírige.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Dirígere et sanctificáre, régere et gubernáre dignáre, Dómine Deus, Rex cæli et terræ, hódie corda et córpora nostra, sensus, sermónes et actus nostros in lege tua, et in opéribus mandatórum tuórum: ut hic et in ætérnum, te auxiliánte, salvi et líberi esse mereámur, Salvátor mundi: Qui vivis et regnas in sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: O Lord, Almighty God, King of heaven and earth, Saviour of the world, bless, lead, rule and govern our hearts and bodies, our senses, words and deeds today, following thy law and commandments, that here and for eternity with thy help we shall be saved in freedom. Who livest and reignest, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Dies et actus nostros in sua pace dispónat Dóminus omnípotens.
content.english: Benediction. May Almighty God arrange our deeds and our day in His peace.

Dies et actus nostros in sua pace dispónat Dóminus omnípotens.

content.latin: 2 Thess 3:5
content.english: 2 Thess 3:5

segments.t: 2 Thess 3:5

content.latin: Dóminus autem dírigat corda et córpora nostra in caritáte Dei et patiéntia Christi.
content.english: And the Lord direct your hearts, in the charity of God, and the patience of Christ.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.
content.english: ℣. Our help is ✠ in the name of the Lord,

segments.t: Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.

content.latin: ℟. Qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: ℟. Who made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: ℣. Benedícite.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless.

segments.t: Benedícite.

content.latin: ℟. Deus.
content.english: ℟. God.

segments.t: Deus.

content.latin: Benedictio. Dóminus nos benedícat, ✠ et ab omni malo deféndat, et ad vitam perdúcat ætérnam. Et fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: Benediction. May the Lord bless us, ✠ protect us from all evil and bring us to everlasting life. And may the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Dóminus nos benedícat, ✠ et ab omni malo deféndat, et ad vitam perdúcat ætérnam. Et fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Nunc, Sancte, nobis, Spíritus,
content.english: Come Holy Ghost who ever One

content.latin: Unum Patri cum Fílio,
content.english: Art with the Father and the Son,

content.latin: Dignáre promptus íngeri
content.english: It is the hour, our souls possess

content.latin: Nostro refúsus péctori.
content.english: With thy full flood of holiness.

content.latin: Os, lingua, mens, sensus, vigor
content.english: Let flesh and heart and lips and mind

content.latin: Confessiónem pérsonent.
content.english: Sound forth our witness to mankind;

content.latin: Flamméscat igne cáritas,
content.english: And love light up our mortal frame,

content.latin: Accéndat ardor próximos.
content.english: Till others catch the living flame.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Almighty Father, hear our cry,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Doth live and reign eternally.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Hi sunt * qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
content.english: Ant. These are they which came out of great tribulation, * and have washed their robes and made them white in the Blood of the Lamb.

segments.t: Ant.
Hi sunt * qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
Psalmus 118(33-48)

content.latin: 118:33 (He) Legem pone mihi, Dómine, viam iustificatiónum tuárum: * et exquíram eam semper.
content.english: 118:33 (He) Set before me for a law the way of thy justifications, O Lord: * and I will always seek after it.

segments.t: Legem pone mihi, Dómine, viam iustificatiónum tuárum: * et exquíram eam semper.

content.latin: 118:34 Da mihi intelléctum, et scrutábor legem tuam: * et custódiam illam in toto corde meo.
content.english: 118:34 Give me understanding, and I will search thy law; * and I will keep it with my whole heart.

segments.t: Da mihi intelléctum, et scrutábor legem tuam: * et custódiam illam in toto corde meo.

content.latin: 118:35 Deduc me in sémitam mandatórum tuórum: * quia ipsam vólui.
content.english: 118:35 Lead me into the path of thy commandments; * for this same I have desired.

segments.t: Deduc me in sémitam mandatórum tuórum: * quia ipsam vólui.

content.latin: 118:36 Inclína cor meum in testimónia tua: * et non in avarítiam.
content.english: 118:36 Incline my heart into thy testimonies * and not to covetousness.

segments.t: Inclína cor meum in testimónia tua: * et non in avarítiam.

content.latin: 118:37 Avérte óculos meos ne vídeant vanitátem: * in via tua vivífica me.
content.english: 118:37 Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity: * quicken me in thy way.

segments.t: Avérte óculos meos ne vídeant vanitátem: * in via tua vivífica me.

content.latin: 118:38 Státue servo tuo elóquium tuum, * in timóre tuo.
content.english: 118:38 Establish thy word to thy servant, * in thy fear.

segments.t: Státue servo tuo elóquium tuum, * in timóre tuo.

content.latin: 118:39 Ámputa oppróbrium meum quod suspicátus sum: * quia iudícia tua iucúnda.
content.english: 118:39 Turn away my reproach, which I have apprehended: * for thy judgments are delightful.

segments.t: Ámputa oppróbrium meum quod suspicátus sum: * quia iudícia tua iucúnda.

content.latin: 118:40 Ecce, concupívi mandáta tua: * in æquitáte tua vivífica me.
content.english: 118:40 Behold I have longed after thy precepts: * quicken me in thy justice.

segments.t: Ecce, concupívi mandáta tua: * in æquitáte tua vivífica me.

content.latin: 118:41 (Vav) Et véniat super me misericórdia tua, Dómine: * salutáre tuum secúndum elóquium tuum.
content.english: 118:41 (Vau) Let thy mercy also come upon me, O Lord: * thy salvation according to thy word.

segments.t: Et véniat super me misericórdia tua, Dómine: * salutáre tuum secúndum elóquium tuum.

content.latin: 118:42 Et respondébo exprobrántibus mihi verbum: * quia sperávi in sermónibus tuis.
content.english: 118:42 So shall I answer them that reproach me in any thing; * that I have trusted in thy words.

segments.t: Et respondébo exprobrántibus mihi verbum: * quia sperávi in sermónibus tuis.

content.latin: 118:43 Et ne áuferas de ore meo verbum veritátis usquequáque: * quia in iudíciis tuis supersperávi.
content.english: 118:43 And take not thou the word of truth utterly out of my mouth: * for in thy words, I have hoped exceedingly.

segments.t: Et ne áuferas de ore meo verbum veritátis usquequáque: * quia in iudíciis tuis supersperávi.

content.latin: 118:44 Et custódiam legem tuam semper: * in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
content.english: 118:44 So shall I always keep thy law, * for ever and ever.

segments.t: Et custódiam legem tuam semper: * in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.

content.latin: 118:45 Et ambulábam in latitúdine: * quia mandáta tua exquisívi.
content.english: 118:45 And I walked at large: * because I have sought after thy commandments.

segments.t: Et ambulábam in latitúdine: * quia mandáta tua exquisívi.

content.latin: 118:46 Et loquébar in testimóniis tuis in conspéctu regum: * et non confundébar.
content.english: 118:46 And I spoke of thy testimonies before kings: * and I was not ashamed.

segments.t: Et loquébar in testimóniis tuis in conspéctu regum: * et non confundébar.

content.latin: 118:47 Et meditábar in mandátis tuis, * quæ diléxi.
content.english: 118:47 I meditated also on thy commandments, * which I loved.

segments.t: Et meditábar in mandátis tuis, * quæ diléxi.

content.latin: 118:48 Et levávi manus meas ad mandáta tua, quæ diléxi: * et exercébar in iustificatiónibus tuis.
content.english: 118:48 And I lifted up my hands to thy commandments, which I loved: * and I was exercised in thy justifications.

segments.t: Et levávi manus meas ad mandáta tua, quæ diléxi: * et exercébar in iustificatiónibus tuis.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 118(49-64)

content.latin: 118:49 (Zai) Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, * in quo mihi spem dedísti.
content.english: 118:49 (Zai) Be thou mindful of thy word to thy servant, * in which thou hast given me hope.

segments.t: Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, * in quo mihi spem dedísti.

content.latin: 118:50 Hæc me consoláta est in humilitáte mea: * quia elóquium tuum vivificávit me.
content.english: 118:50 This hath comforted me in my humiliation: * because thy word hath enlivened me.

segments.t: Hæc me consoláta est in humilitáte mea: * quia elóquium tuum vivificávit me.

content.latin: 118:51 Supérbi iníque agébant usquequáque: * a lege autem tua non declinávi.
content.english: 118:51 The proud did iniquitously altogether: * but I declined not from thy law.

segments.t: Supérbi iníque agébant usquequáque: * a lege autem tua non declinávi.

content.latin: 118:52 Memor fui iudiciórum tuórum a sǽculo, Dómine: * et consolátus sum.
content.english: 118:52 I remembered, O Lord, thy judgments of old: * and I was comforted.

segments.t: Memor fui iudiciórum tuórum a sǽculo, Dómine: * et consolátus sum.

content.latin: 118:53 Deféctio ténuit me, * pro peccatóribus derelinquéntibus legem tuam.
content.english: 118:53 A fainting hath taken hold of me, * because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

segments.t: Deféctio ténuit me, * pro peccatóribus derelinquéntibus legem tuam.

content.latin: 118:54 Cantábiles mihi erant iustificatiónes tuæ, * in loco peregrinatiónis meæ.
content.english: 118:54 Thy justifications were the subject of my song, * in the place of my pilgrimage.

segments.t: Cantábiles mihi erant iustificatiónes tuæ, * in loco peregrinatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 118:55 Memor fui nocte nóminis tui, Dómine: * et custodívi legem tuam.
content.english: 118:55 In the night I have remembered thy name, O Lord: * and have kept thy law.

segments.t: Memor fui nocte nóminis tui, Dómine: * et custodívi legem tuam.

content.latin: 118:56 Hæc facta est mihi: * quia iustificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
content.english: 118:56 This happened to me: * because I sought after thy justifications.

segments.t: Hæc facta est mihi: * quia iustificatiónes tuas exquisívi.

content.latin: 118:57 (Heth) Pórtio mea, Dómine, * dixi custodíre legem tuam.
content.english: 118:57 (Heth) O Lord, my portion, * I have said, I would keep thy law.

segments.t: Pórtio mea, Dómine, * dixi custodíre legem tuam.

content.latin: 118:58 Deprecátus sum fáciem tuam in toto corde meo: * miserére mei secúndum elóquium tuum.
content.english: 118:58 I entreated thy face with all my heart: * have mercy on me according to thy word.

segments.t: Deprecátus sum fáciem tuam in toto corde meo: * miserére mei secúndum elóquium tuum.

content.latin: 118:59 Cogitávi vias meas: * et convérti pedes meos in testimónia tua.
content.english: 118:59 I have thought on my ways: * and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

segments.t: Cogitávi vias meas: * et convérti pedes meos in testimónia tua.

content.latin: 118:60 Parátus sum, et non sum turbátus: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:60 I am ready, and am not troubled: * that I may keep thy commandments.

segments.t: Parátus sum, et non sum turbátus: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:61 Funes peccatórum circumpléxi sunt me: * et legem tuam non sum oblítus.
content.english: 118:61 The cords of the wicked have encompassed me: * but I have not forgotten thy law.

segments.t: Funes peccatórum circumpléxi sunt me: * et legem tuam non sum oblítus.

content.latin: 118:62 Média nocte surgébam ad confiténdum tibi, * super iudícia iustificatiónis tuæ.
content.english: 118:62 I rose at midnight to give praise to thee; * for the judgments of thy justification.

segments.t: Média nocte surgébam ad confiténdum tibi, * super iudícia iustificatiónis tuæ.

content.latin: 118:63 Párticeps ego sum ómnium timéntium te: * et custodiéntium mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:63 I am a partaker with all them that fear thee, * and that keep thy commandments.

segments.t: Párticeps ego sum ómnium timéntium te: * et custodiéntium mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:64 Misericórdia tua, Dómine, plena est terra: * iustificatiónes tuas doce me.
content.english: 118:64 The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: * teach me thy justifications.

segments.t: Misericórdia tua, Dómine, plena est terra: * iustificatiónes tuas doce me.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 118(65-80)

content.latin: 118:65 (Teth) Bonitátem fecísti cum servo tuo, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum.
content.english: 118:65 (Teth) Thou hast done well with thy servant, O Lord, * according to thy word.

segments.t: Bonitátem fecísti cum servo tuo, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum.

content.latin: 118:66 Bonitátem, et disciplínam, et sciéntiam doce me: * quia mandátis tuis crédidi.
content.english: 118:66 Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge; * for I have believed thy commandments.

segments.t: Bonitátem, et disciplínam, et sciéntiam doce me: * quia mandátis tuis crédidi.

content.latin: 118:67 Priúsquam humiliárer ego delíqui: * proptérea elóquium tuum custodívi.
content.english: 118:67 Before I was humbled I offended; * therefore have I kept thy word.

segments.t: Priúsquam humiliárer ego delíqui: * proptérea elóquium tuum custodívi.

content.latin: 118:68 Bonus es tu: * et in bonitáte tua doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
content.english: 118:68 Thou art good; * and in thy goodness teach me thy justifications.

segments.t: Bonus es tu: * et in bonitáte tua doce me iustificatiónes tuas.

content.latin: 118:69 Multiplicáta est super me iníquitas superbórum: * ego autem in toto corde meo scrutábor mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:69 The iniquity of the proud hath been multiplied over me: * but I will seek thy commandments with my whole heart.

segments.t: Multiplicáta est super me iníquitas superbórum: * ego autem in toto corde meo scrutábor mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:70 Coagulátum est sicut lac cor eórum: * ego vero legem tuam meditátus sum.
content.english: 118:70 Their heart is curdled like milk: * but I have meditated on thy law.

segments.t: Coagulátum est sicut lac cor eórum: * ego vero legem tuam meditátus sum.

content.latin: 118:71 Bonum mihi quia humiliásti me: * ut discam iustificatiónes tuas.
content.english: 118:71 It is good for me that thou hast humbled me, * that I may learn thy justifications.

segments.t: Bonum mihi quia humiliásti me: * ut discam iustificatiónes tuas.

content.latin: 118:72 Bonum mihi lex oris tui, * super míllia auri et argénti.
content.english: 118:72 The law of thy mouth is good to me, * above thousands of gold and silver.

segments.t: Bonum mihi lex oris tui, * super míllia auri et argénti.

content.latin: 118:73 (Ioth) Manus tuæ fecérunt me, et plasmavérunt me: * da mihi intelléctum, et discam mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:73 (Jod) Thy hands have made me and formed me: * give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.

segments.t: Manus tuæ fecérunt me, et plasmavérunt me: * da mihi intelléctum, et discam mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:74 Qui timent te vidébunt me, et lætabúntur: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.
content.english: 118:74 They that fear thee shall see me, and shall be glad: * because I have greatly hoped in thy words.

segments.t: Qui timent te vidébunt me, et lætabúntur: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.

content.latin: 118:75 Cognóvi, Dómine, quia ǽquitas iudícia tua: * et in veritáte tua humiliásti me.
content.english: 118:75 I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are equity: * and in thy truth thou hast humbled me.

segments.t: Cognóvi, Dómine, quia ǽquitas iudícia tua: * et in veritáte tua humiliásti me.

content.latin: 118:76 Fiat misericórdia tua ut consolétur me, * secúndum elóquium tuum servo tuo.
content.english: 118:76 O! let thy mercy be for my comfort, * according to thy word unto thy servant.

segments.t: Fiat misericórdia tua ut consolétur me, * secúndum elóquium tuum servo tuo.

content.latin: 118:77 Véniant mihi miseratiónes tuæ, et vivam: * quia lex tua meditátio mea est.
content.english: 118:77 Let thy tender mercies come unto me, and I shall live: * for thy law is my meditation.

segments.t: Véniant mihi miseratiónes tuæ, et vivam: * quia lex tua meditátio mea est.

content.latin: 118:78 Confundántur supérbi, quia iniúste iniquitátem fecérunt in me: * ego autem exercébor in mandátis tuis.
content.english: 118:78 Let the proud be ashamed, because they have done unjustly towards me: * but I will be employed in thy commandments.

segments.t: Confundántur supérbi, quia iniúste iniquitátem fecérunt in me: * ego autem exercébor in mandátis tuis.

content.latin: 118:79 Convertántur mihi timéntes te: * et qui novérunt testimónia tua.
content.english: 118:79 Let them that fear thee turn to me: * and they that know thy testimonies.

segments.t: Convertántur mihi timéntes te: * et qui novérunt testimónia tua.

content.latin: 118:80 Fiat cor meum immaculátum in iustificatiónibus tuis, * ut non confúndar.
content.english: 118:80 Let my heart be undefiled in thy justifications, * that I may not be confounded.

segments.t: Fiat cor meum immaculátum in iustificatiónibus tuis, * ut non confúndar.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Hi sunt qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
content.english: Ant. These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes and made them white in the Blood of the Lamb.

segments.t: Ant.
Hi sunt qui venérunt de tribulatióne magna et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.

content.latin: Fratres: Christus assístens Póntifex futurórum bonórum, per ámplius et perféctius tabernáculum non manufáctum, id est, non huius creatiónis: neque per sánguinem hircórum aut vitulórum, sed per próprium sánguinem introívit semel in Sancta, ætérna redemptióne invénta.
content.english: Brethren, Christ being come an High Priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by His Own Blood, He entered in once into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℟.br. Redemísti nos, Dómine, * In sánguine tuo.
content.english: ℟.br. Lord, Thou hast redeemed us * by thy Blood.

segments.t: ℟.br.
Redemísti nos, Dómine, * In sánguine tuo.

content.latin: ℟. Redemísti nos, Dómine, * In sánguine tuo.
content.english: ℟. Lord, Thou hast redeemed us * by thy Blood.

segments.t: Redemísti nos, Dómine, * In sánguine tuo.

content.latin: ℣. Ex omni tribu, et lingua, et pópulo, et natióne.
content.english: ℣. Out of every kindred, and tongue, and people.

segments.t: Ex omni tribu, et lingua, et pópulo, et natióne.

content.latin: ℟. In sánguine tuo.
content.english: ℟. By thy Blood.

segments.t: In sánguine tuo.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Redemísti nos, Dómine, * In sánguine tuo.
content.english: ℟. Lord, Thou hast redeemed us * by thy Blood.

segments.t: Redemísti nos, Dómine, * In sánguine tuo.

content.latin: ℣. Sanguis Iesu Christi Fílii Dei.
content.english: ℣. The blood of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

segments.t: Sanguis Iesu Christi Fílii Dei.

content.latin: ℟. Emúndat nos ab omni peccáto.
content.english: ℟. Cleanseth us from all sin.

segments.t: Emúndat nos ab omni peccáto.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui unigénitum Fílium tuum mundi Redemptórem constituísti, ac eius Sánguine placári voluísti: concéde, quǽsumus, salútis nostræ prétium solémni cultu ita venerári, atque a præséntis vitæ malis eius virtúte deféndi in terris; ut fructu perpétuo lætémur in cælis.
content.english: Almighty, eternal God, Who made thy only-begotten Son the Redeemer of the world, and willed to be reconciled by His Blood, grant us, we beseech thee, so to worship in this sacred rite the price of our salvation, and to be so protected by its power against the evils of the present life on earth, that we may enjoy its everlasting fruit in heaven.

content.latin: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through the same Jesus Christ, thy Son, Our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Rector potens, verax Deus,
content.english: O God of truth, O Lord of might,

content.latin: Qui témperas rerum vices,
content.english: Who orderest time and change aright,

content.latin: Splendóre mane illúminas,
content.english: Who send’st the early morning ray,

content.latin: Et ígnibus merídiem:
content.english: And light’st the glow of perfect day:

content.latin: Exstíngue flammas lítium,
content.english: Extinguish thou each sinful fire,

content.latin: Aufer calórem nóxium,
content.english: And banish every ill desire;

content.latin: Confer salútem córporum,
content.english: And while thou keep’st the body whole,

content.latin: Verámque pacem córdium.
content.english: Shed forth thy peace upon the soul.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Almighty Father, hear our cry,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Doth live and reign eternally.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Ideo sunt * ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.
content.english: Ant. Therefore are they before the throne of God, * and serve Him day and night.

segments.t: Ant.
Ideo sunt * ante thronum Dei et sérviunt ei die ac nocte.
Psalmus 118(81-96)

content.latin: 118:81 (Caph) Defécit in salutáre tuum ánima mea: * et in verbum tuum supersperávi.
content.english: 118:81 (Caph) My soul hath fainted after thy salvation: * and in thy word I have very much hoped.

segments.t: Defécit in salutáre tuum ánima mea: * et in verbum tuum supersperávi.

content.latin: 118:82 Defecérunt óculi mei in elóquium tuum, * dicéntes: Quando consoláberis me?
content.english: 118:82 My eyes have failed for thy word, * saying: When wilt thou comfort me?

segments.t: Defecérunt óculi mei in elóquium tuum, * dicéntes: Quando consoláberis me?

content.latin: 118:83 Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruína: * iustificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
content.english: 118:83 For I am become like a bottle in the frost: * I have not forgotten thy justifications.

segments.t: Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruína: * iustificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.

content.latin: 118:84 Quot sunt dies servi tui? * quando fácies de persequéntibus me iudícium?
content.english: 118:84 How many are the days of thy servant: * when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

segments.t: Quot sunt dies servi tui? * quando fácies de persequéntibus me iudícium?

content.latin: 118:85 Narravérunt mihi iníqui fabulatiónes: * sed non ut lex tua.
content.english: 118:85 The wicked have told me fables: * but not as thy law.

segments.t: Narravérunt mihi iníqui fabulatiónes: * sed non ut lex tua.

content.latin: 118:86 Ómnia mandáta tua véritas: * iníque persecúti sunt me, ádiuva me.
content.english: 118:86 All thy statutes are truth: * they have persecuted me unjustly, do thou help me.

segments.t: Ómnia mandáta tua véritas: * iníque persecúti sunt me, ádiuva me.

content.latin: 118:87 Paulo minus consummavérunt me in terra: * ego autem non derelíqui mandáta tua.
content.english: 118:87 They had almost made an end of me upon earth: * but I have not forsaken thy commandments.

segments.t: Paulo minus consummavérunt me in terra: * ego autem non derelíqui mandáta tua.

content.latin: 118:88 Secúndum misericórdiam tuam vivífica me: * et custódiam testimónia oris tui.
content.english: 118:88 Quicken thou me according to thy mercy: * and I shall keep the testimonies of thy mouth.

segments.t: Secúndum misericórdiam tuam vivífica me: * et custódiam testimónia oris tui.

content.latin: 118:89 (Lamed) In ætérnum, Dómine, * verbum tuum pérmanet in cælo.
content.english: 118:89 (Lamed) For ever, O Lord, * thy word standeth firm in heaven.

segments.t: In ætérnum, Dómine, * verbum tuum pérmanet in cælo.

content.latin: 118:90 In generatiónem et generatiónem véritas tua: * fundásti terram, et pérmanet.
content.english: 118:90 Thy truth unto all generations: * thou hast founded the earth, and it continueth.

segments.t: In generatiónem et generatiónem véritas tua: * fundásti terram, et pérmanet.

content.latin: 118:91 Ordinatióne tua persevérat dies: * quóniam ómnia sérviunt tibi.
content.english: 118:91 By thy ordinance the day goeth on: * for all things serve thee.

segments.t: Ordinatióne tua persevérat dies: * quóniam ómnia sérviunt tibi.

content.latin: 118:92 Nisi quod lex tua meditátio mea est: * tunc forte periíssem in humilitáte mea.
content.english: 118:92 Unless thy law had been my meditation, * I had then perhaps perished in my abjection.

segments.t: Nisi quod lex tua meditátio mea est: * tunc forte periíssem in humilitáte mea.

content.latin: 118:93 In ætérnum non oblivíscar iustificatiónes tuas: * quia in ipsis vivificásti me.
content.english: 118:93 Thy justifications I will never forget: * for by them thou hast given me life.

segments.t: In ætérnum non oblivíscar iustificatiónes tuas: * quia in ipsis vivificásti me.

content.latin: 118:94 Tuus sum ego, salvum me fac: * quóniam iustificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
content.english: 118:94 I am thine, save thou me: * for I have sought thy justifications.

segments.t: Tuus sum ego, salvum me fac: * quóniam iustificatiónes tuas exquisívi.

content.latin: 118:95 Me exspectavérunt peccatóres ut pérderent me: * testimónia tua intelléxi.
content.english: 118:95 The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: * but I have understood thy testimonies.

segments.t: Me exspectavérunt peccatóres ut pérderent me: * testimónia tua intelléxi.

content.latin: 118:96 Omnis consummatiónis vidi finem: * latum mandátum tuum nimis.
content.english: 118:96 I have seen an end of all perfection: * thy commandment is exceeding broad.

segments.t: Omnis consummatiónis vidi finem: * latum mandátum tuum nimis.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: 118:97 (Mem) Quómodo diléxi legem tuam, Dómine? * tota die meditátio mea est.
content.english: 118:97 (Mem) How have I loved thy law, O Lord! * it is my meditation all the day.

segments.t: Quómodo diléxi legem tuam, Dómine? * tota die meditátio mea est.

content.latin: 118:98 Super inimícos meos prudéntem me fecísti mandáto tuo: * quia in ætérnum mihi est.
content.english: 118:98 Through thy commandment, thou hast made me wiser than my enemies: * for it is ever with me.

segments.t: Super inimícos meos prudéntem me fecísti mandáto tuo: * quia in ætérnum mihi est.

content.latin: 118:99 Super omnes docéntes me intelléxi: * quia testimónia tua meditátio mea est.
content.english: 118:99 I have understood more than all my teachers: * because thy testimonies are my meditation.

segments.t: Super omnes docéntes me intelléxi: * quia testimónia tua meditátio mea est.

content.latin: 118:100 Super senes intelléxi: * quia mandáta tua quæsívi.
content.english: 118:100 I have had understanding above ancients: * because I have sought thy commandments.

segments.t: Super senes intelléxi: * quia mandáta tua quæsívi.

content.latin: 118:101 Ab omni via mala prohíbui pedes meos: * ut custódiam verba tua.
content.english: 118:101 I have restrained my feet from every evil way: * that I may keep thy words.

segments.t: Ab omni via mala prohíbui pedes meos: * ut custódiam verba tua.

content.latin: 118:102 A iudíciis tuis non declinávi: * quia tu legem posuísti mihi.
content.english: 118:102 I have not declined from thy judgments, * because thou hast set me a law.

segments.t: A iudíciis tuis non declinávi: * quia tu legem posuísti mihi.

content.latin: 118:103 Quam dúlcia fáucibus meis elóquia tua, * super mel ori meo!
content.english: 118:103 How sweet are thy words to my palate! * more than honey to my mouth.

segments.t: Quam dúlcia fáucibus meis elóquia tua, * super mel ori meo!
